name: Release 2.2.366
body:
This is a security release. It raises the Pillow requirement of `presidio-image-redactor` to 13.0.0, refreshes every lock file to clear 100 known advisories, locks Transformers 5.16.1 in the analyzer, and ships slimmed container images plus new distroless variants. It also drops Python 3.10.

Packages: `presidio-analyzer` 2.2.366, `presidio-anonymizer` 2.2.366, `presidio` 2.2.366, `presidio-image-redactor` 0.0.62, `presidio-structured` 0.0.10.

## Upgrade notes

- **Python 3.10 is no longer supported.** Python 3.10 reached end of life on 2026-10-01. All packages now require Python `>=3.11,<3.15`. Installs on Python 3.10 resolve to the previous releases.
- **`presidio-image-redactor` requires Pillow 13.** The requirement is now `pillow>=13.0.0,<14.0.0`. Pillow 13 fixes the 41 security advisories (5 critical, 23 high) open against Pillow 12.3.0 (#2393).
- **The spaCy factory `hf_token_pipe` is gone.** The analyzer no longer depends on `spacy-huggingface-pipelines`. `TransformersNlpEngine` now registers its own `presidio_hf_token_pipe` factory. A spaCy pipeline saved with `nlp.to_disk()` that references `hf_token_pipe` no longer loads; Presidio never saves such a pipeline itself. Detection results and scores are unchanged.
- **New minimums for the analyzer extras.** The `transformers` extra requires `transformers>=4.28.0,<6.0.0`. The `gliner` extra requires `gliner>=0.2.29`, `transformers>=4.51.3,<5.17.0` and a single `onnxruntime>=1.19`. Installing Transformers 5.10 or later is recommended to pick up the security fixes.
- **Container images no longer ship `curl`.** The image `HEALTHCHECK` now probes `/health` with the Python standard library and ignores `HTTP_PROXY`. The `docker-compose.yml` healthcheck overrides were removed so the image healthchecks apply. Existing image tags keep their names.

## Security

- Slimmed and hardened the default analyzer and anonymizer images: the `python:3.12-slim` and `python:3.14-slim` bases are re-pinned with OS security updates applied, uv is bind-mounted at build time instead of installed, and setuptools and wheel (plus pip in the anonymizer) are removed from the final image. Trivy critical, high and medium findings drop from 321 to 103 (anonymizer) and from 345 to 113 (analyzer). (#2407)
- Refreshed every `uv.lock` file to fix the 100 known advisories in the locked development and CI dependencies, including `pillow` 13.0.0, `virtualenv` 21.14.13, `pyjwt` 2.15.1, `aiohttp` 3.14.5, `urllib3` 2.8.0, `cryptography` 50.0.2, `filelock` 4.2.4, `oauthlib` 4.0.0 and `certifi` 2026.10.23. Apart from the Pillow and onnxruntime requirements above, published dependency ranges are unchanged. (#2409)
- Locked `transformers` to 5.16.1 in the analyzer, which fixes GHSA-xrqw-3rrv-vx5w and GHSA-x9r9-c232-4q39. (#2201)
- Raised the `presidio-image-redactor` Pillow requirement to 13 and replaced the `Image.getdata()` call in the DICOM redactor with `get_flattened_data()`, since `getdata()` is deprecated in Pillow 13 and removed in Pillow 14. (#2393, #2409)

## Added

- **Distroless container images.** The analyzer and anonymizer are also published as distroless images built on Azure Linux, tagged `<version>-distroless` and `latest-distroless` in the same GHCR repositories. The unsuffixed tags, including `latest`, remain the default images. The distroless images contain no shell, package manager, pip or uv, run Python 3.12 as UID 65532, listen on port 3000, and take gunicorn settings through `GUNICORN_CMD_ARGS` instead of `PORT` and `WORKERS`. Trivy findings are 1 (anonymizer) and 6 (analyzer). A `docker-compose.distroless.yml` override runs them locally. (#2407)

  ```sh
  docker pull ghcr.io/data-privacy-stack/presidio-analyzer:2.2.366-distroless
  docker pull ghcr.io/data-privacy-stack/presidio-anonymizer:2.2.366-distroless
  ```

- **Context-aware enhancer configuration in YAML.** A new optional `context_aware_enhancer` section in the analyzer configuration sets the `LemmaContextAwareEnhancer` parameters (`context_similarity_factor`, `min_score_with_context_similarity`, `context_prefix_count`, `context_suffix_count`, `context_matching_mode`) without Python code. Invalid values are rejected at parse time with an actionable message. Configurations without the section keep the previous defaults. (#2373)

## Fixed

- The documentation publishing workflow no longer deletes the `CNAME` file, which took `presidio.dataprivacystack.org` offline after every publish. Canonical links and the sitemap now use the custom domain. (#2410)
- The documented `docker run` port mapping for a source-built anonymizer image now maps to container port 3000. (#2407)

## What's Changed

* fix(docs): keep custom domain when publishing to gh-pages by @omri374 in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2410
* feat(analyzer): make the context-aware enhancer configurable via analyzer YAML by @MetehanAydemir in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2373
* Replace stale Hugging Face spaCy adapter by @SharonHart in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2201
* fix(security): patch vulnerable dependencies incl. Pillow 13; drop Python 3.10 by @SharonHart in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2409
* fix(images): slim down and harden analyzer/anonymizer images by @SharonHart in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2407
* Release 2.2.366 / 0.0.62 by @omri374 in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2424

## New Contributors

* @MetehanAydemir made their first contribution in https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/pull/2373

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio/compare/2.2.365...2.2.366

### Analyzer
#### Added
- Korean Resident Registration Number (RRN) recognizer with checksum validation for numbers issued prior to October 2020 (#1675) (Thanks @siwoo-jung)
- Azure Health Data Services (AHDS) de-identification service integration as a remote recognizer with Entra ID authentication (#1624) (Thanks @rishasurana)
- Comprehensive input validation methods for NlpEngineProvider to ensure valid arguments for engines, configuration, and file paths (#1653) (Thanks @siwoo-jung)

#### Changed
- Updated Indian Aadhaar recognizer to support contextual delimiters (-, :, space) for improved detection accuracy (#1677) (Thanks @K3y5tr0ke)
- Fixed Italian Driver License recognizer regex to include missing characters per government requirements, excluding only A, O, Q, I (#1651) (Thanks @K3y5tr0ke)
- Refactored recognizers folder structure for better organization and maintainability (#1670) (Thanks @omri374)

### Anonymizer
#### Added
- Azure Health Data Services (AHDS) Surrogate anonymization operator with medical domain expertise for realistic PHI surrogate generation (#1672) (Thanks @rishasurana)

#### Changed
- Fixed code indentation issues in encrypt.py for better code quality (#1660) (Thanks @aliyss)

### General
#### Added
- Comprehensive GitHub Copilot instructions with development guidelines, build processes, and e2e testing procedures (#1693) (Thanks @Copilot)
- New GitHub Actions CI & release workflows with multi-platform Docker image support for AMD64 and ARM64 architectures (#1697) (Thanks @tamirkamara)
- Dual-path CI workflow to fix GitHub Actions failures for external contributors by auto-detecting fork vs. main repository PRs (#1708) (Thanks @Copilot)
- OIDC trusted publishing for PyPI releases eliminating manual API token management and enhancing security (#1702) (Thanks @Copilot)
- Comprehensive YAML and Python examples for context-aware recognizers documentation (#1710) (Thanks @MRADULTRIPATHI)

#### Changed
- Updated actions/checkout from v4 to v5 to support Node.js 24 runtime (#1699) (Thanks @dependabot)
- Fixed PR template to use proper GitHub issue linking syntax for automatic issue association and closing (#1701) (Thanks @Copilot)
- Updated LiteLLM documentation with detailed guide links for better integration guidance (#1698) (Thanks @BhargavDT)
- Fixed broken links in CONTRIBUTING.md and developing recognizers documentation after recognizers refactoring (#1674) (Thanks @siwoo-jung)
- Fixed OpenSSF badge embedding in README.MD for proper display (#1673) (Thanks @SharonHart)
- Removed Terrascan from Microsoft Defender for DevOps workflow to eliminate false positives on non-IAC repository (#1691) (Thanks @Copilot)

#### Security
- Updated Streamlit and PyTorch dependency versions to fix CVE vulnerabilities (#1685) (Thanks @SharonHart)
- Updated requests library to mitigate security vulnerability GHSA-9hjg-9r4m-mvj7 (#1683) (Thanks @SharonHart)
- Locked pandas dependency in Streamlit to prevent version conflicts (#1689) (Thanks @SharonHart)

# Release 2.2.359
This is a period release with feature enhancements, bug fixes, documentation updates and one configuration change.

### Changes in Presidio's behavior

#### Turn country specific recognizers to disabled to avoid false positives when they are not needed.
Most country specific recognizers that expect English were put as optional to avoid false positives, and would not work out-of-the-box (#1586). Specifically:
    - SgFinRecognizer
    - AuAbnRecognizer
    - AuAcnRecognizer
    - AuTfnRecognizer
    - AuMedicareRecognizer
    - InPanRecognizer
    - InAadhaarRecognizer
    - InVehicleRegistrationRecognizer
    - InPassportRecognizer
    - EsNifRecognizer
    - InVoterRecognizer

  To re-enable them, either change the [default YAML](https://github.com/microsoft/presidio/blob/main/presidio-analyzer/presidio_analyzer/conf/default_recognizers.yaml) to have them as `enabled: true`, or via code, add them to the recognizer registry manually.
    - Yaml based: see more here: [YAML based configuration](https://microsoft.github.io/presidio/analyzer/analyzer_engine_provider/).
    - Code based:
   
```py
from presidio_analyzer import AnalyzerEngine
from presidio_analyzer.predefined_recognizers import AuAbnRecognizer

# Initialize an analyzer engine with the recognizer registry
analyzer = AnalyzerEngine()

# Create an instance of the AuAbnRecognizer
au_abn_recognizer = AuAbnRecognizer()

# Add the recognizer to the registry
analyzer.registry.add_recognizer(au_abn_recognizer)
  ```
